answer: Rule: every identity completes one sequential VDF proof per epoch, ten minutes of single-thread compute that cannot be split across cores. Work flows like a river through one narrow channel, never in parallel. One fake costs ten minutes; one hundred fakes cost one hundred machines or 1,000 minutes, so cost scales linearly and the tide of new identities is capped by real time. A late proof, or one missing the epoch pigment tag, is rejected and the 20-unit stake is burned.
